title: Add Go and Rust to the governed programming-language architecture
summary: Register Go for bounded concurrent services and Rust for memory-safe systems capabilities without granting either language governance, permission or business authority.

changes.proposed: STACK:c11+c++17+csharp+fsharp+go+rust+python+typescript+sql hybrid; C:approved deterministic rules+permission hot paths+resident runtime+native tests; CPP:object-oriented native capabilities+inference+native tests+approved audit hot paths; CSHARP:interfaces+typed adapters+authorized workflow orchestration+sole test orchestration; FSHARP:data analysis+machine learning+high-correctness complex calculation; GO:bounded concurrent services+transport workers+network adapters+portable operational binaries through versioned contracts; RUST:memory-safe systems capabilities+parsers+integrity/security-sensitive native components through versioned C ABI or typed service contracts; PYTHON:on-demand gate adjudication+necessary governance semantics+model research/training+unavoidable boundaries only and nonresident after request completion; TYPESCRIPT:presentation+build-time type safety; SQL:data operations+structured authoritative persistence within declared authority boundaries; SOLE:allowed-code-architecture

MATRIX:{system-orchestration=>owner:Python;callers:TypeScript+CSharp+C+++Go+Rust adapters;deny:adapter second orchestration}+{UI-state-and-presentation=>owner:TypeScript;caller:typed API data provider;deny:backend DOM control}+{Native-ABI=>owner:C;callers:Python+CSharp+Go+Rust+pybind11;deny:public C++ ABI}+{high-performance-algorithms=>owner:C++;callers:C ABI and approved bindings only;deny:duplicate authoritative implementation}+{Windows-DotNET=>owner:CSharp;callers:typed adapters+C ABI;deny:CSharp cross-platform domain logic}+{bounded-concurrent-service=>owner:Go;callers:versioned information/service contracts;deny:Go governance+permission+business judgment}+{memory-safe-systems-capability=>owner:Rust;callers:C ABI or versioned typed service contracts;deny:Rust governance+permission+business judgment}+{relational-data-operation=>owner:SQL;caller:application services;deny:fetch-all-then-filter}+{business-semantics=>owner:Python;callers:UI+API;deny:SQL/native/service languages independent business judgment}; UNIQUENESS:each capability has exactly one authoritative language owner and callers are adapters/consumers only; CALL-PATH:every cross-language call is typed+versioned+tested; FALLBACK:a fallback preserves behavior but cannot become a second active owner; CHANGE:owner transfer requires successor law+affected graph+atomic migration+old-owner removal+release hard gate.

CORE-ORDER:correctness-first>declared-language-owner>representative reproducible profile>contract and behavior oracle>independent acceptance>certified activation. NEW-FEATURE follows A604: execution modules prefer C/C++;C11 owns approved deterministic rules,resident runtime and native tests;C++ owns native capabilities,inference,native tests and approved audit hot paths;C# owns interfaces and authorized orchestration;F# owns analysis,machine learning and high-correctness complex calculation;Go owns bounded concurrent services,transport workers,network adapters and portable operational binaries;Rust owns memory-safe systems capabilities,parsers and integrity/security-sensitive native components;Python is limited to on-demand governance semantics,model research/training and unavoidable boundaries. Go and Rust activation requires versioned contracts,toolchain evidence,owned tests,resource bounds and failure semantics;neither gains governance,permission or business authority. Promotion grants execution only. Missing or stale evidence,contract drift,failed parity or unsupported platform blocks activation and restores the last verified path.

GATE-NAME:LANGUAGE BOUNDARY GATE; VERDICT:exactly PASS|WARN|FAIL; TRIGGERS:save>pre-commit>integration>release; CHECKS:language_allowed+extension_valid+source_origin_valid+owner_valid+directory_valid+dependency_direction_valid+ABI_valid+API_contract_valid+duplicate_owner_absent+test_present+fallback_present+source_size_valid under A185. Tests follow the owning language and cross-language parity is mandatory. SEMANTICS:FAIL blocks trigger,WARN requires owner+evidence+expiry and never equals PASS,PASS requires all mandatory checks complete.

SUCCESSOR:A604 supersedes A591 and A592 and controls five-core and historical-sub-sovereign responsibility convergence. SUB-SOVEREIGN-LAYER:abolished; former identities are retired lineage only. MODULES execute domain work without independent authority. LANGUAGE-RESPONSIBILITY:C11 executes approved deterministic rules,permission hot paths,resident runtime and native tests;C++ owns native capabilities,inference,native tests and approved audit hot paths;CSharp owns interfaces,authorized orchestration and the sole TestSuiteOrchestrator;FSharp owns analysis,ML and high-correctness calculation;Go owns bounded concurrent services,transport workers,network adapters and portable operational binaries;Rust owns memory-safe systems capabilities,parsers and integrity/security-sensitive native components;Python is bounded on-demand governance/model research/training/boundary only. Go and Rust acquire execution ownership only through registered versioned contracts and never acquire governance,permission or business authority. FIVE-CORE-SUITE-AUTONOMY:each core independently adjusts owned suites subject to language rules. CAPABILITY-DISPATCH:MODULE_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY/v1 and RULE_CAPABILITY_DISPATCH_V1 remain controlling and fail closed on absent,invalid or ambiguous routes.
